description: This Python source file defines a class `OpenAIResponsesHandler` used for processing and applying guardrail modifications to OpenAI Response API formats. It includes methods for processing input messages, output responses, streaming responses, extracting content, and mapping responses back to original message structures. It heavily relies on specific project modules and data structures related to guardrails, responses, and transformation utilities.
